items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: But Marie would work in them nightclub, you know? Yeah. Played a regular nightclub with them regular jobs.

ctx.x: Yeah, a long time ago. I never did get the hearing. Did you play with him very much?

Yeah, I played with all them bands, yeah. All in all, if you need to be sure to come get them. Yeah. But Marie would work in them nightclub, you know? Yeah. Played a regular nightclub with them regular jobs.
How long did you take lessons from Mr. Cottrell?
